name: Retire 2030 with a 72(t) SEPP bridge
description: Retire mid-2030 and open a 72(t) SEPP on the traditional IRA (which absorbs the 401(k) at separation). Substantially equal periodic payments give penalty-free access to pre-tax money before 59 1/2 — the bridge that rule of 55 would have provided if the 401(k) had stayed in the plan. Compare against base-case, where the same withdrawals pay the 10% early-distribution penalty.
